title: EuPizza / Voice AI Support Agent
subtitle: Multi-Tenant Voice AI Customer Service SaaS Platform
summary: Intelligent voice agent for restaurants. Real-time WebRTC/SIP communication via LiveKit, Deepgram STT, GPT-4o-mini LLM, ElevenLabs TTS, and menu OCR with Pytesseract.
overview: Multi-tenant SaaS platform deploying autonomous voice agents for phone customer service in restaurants and pizzerias, ensuring low-latency conversational audio and dynamic menu customization.
roleDescription: Software Architect and Lead Backend / AI Engineer.
responsibilities: Engineered microservices architecture on Docker Swarm integrated with SIP trunks and WebRTC media server (LiveKit).
Developed Python (FastAPI/Flask) voice agent and orchestrated the AI pipeline: Silero VAD -> Deepgram STT -> GPT-4o-mini LLM -> ElevenLabs / OpenAI TTS.
Implemented OCR engine using Pytesseract and Pillow to extract menu text from images and dynamically construct multi-tenant prompts.
Persisted multi-tenant data in PostgreSQL on Supabase using Row Level Security (RLS).
Built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, Makefile, Ruff, MyPy, and Pytest.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Conversational audio latency bottleneck during real-time phone calls.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Utilized LiveKit Voice Agents with Silero VAD for natural user interruption and optimized Deepgram nova-2-general + GPT-4o-mini models.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Complex and manual onboarding for new restaurant menus.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Automated OCR pipeline (Pytesseract) analyzing menu images and dynamically generating multi-tenant agent prompts.

metrics: End-to-end speech-to-speech latency maintained in milliseconds
100% multi-tenant architecture designed for Docker Swarm scalability
